readings: Counting only payments linked to a rental, and taking each rental's store from the inventory copy that was rented: compute each rental's total payment (sum of its payments). Compute one overall average of these rental totals across all stores. For each store, take the rentals whose total exceeds that overall average. Return the store id, the sum of those rentals' payment totals, and the average amount by which those rentals' totals exceed the overall average. Averages ignore missing values and nothing is rounded.

Counting only payments linked to a rental, and taking each rental's store from the inventory copy that was rented: compute each rental's total payment (sum of its payments). Compute a separate average of rental totals within each store. For each store, take the rentals whose total exceeds that store's own average. Return the store id, the sum of those rentals' payment totals, and the average amount by which those rentals' totals exceed that store's own average. Averages ignore missing values and nothing is rounded.
queries:
WITH rt AS (
  SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id
),
ov AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM rt
)
SELECT rt.store_id,
       SUM(rt.total) AS total_payment,
       AVG(rt.total - ov.avg_total) AS avg_excess
FROM rt, ov
WHERE rt.total > ov.avg_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id;
WITH rt AS (
  SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id
),
sa AS (
  SELECT store_id, AVG(total) AS avg_total
  FROM rt
  GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT rt.store_id,
       SUM(rt.total) AS total_payment,
       AVG(rt.total - sa.avg_total) AS avg_excess
FROM rt
JOIN sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id
WHERE rt.total > sa.avg_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id;
